issue_context.title: Wrong current_tags from device created with udev_monitor_receive_device

```text
…
```

`udev_device_get_current_tags_list_entry` returns always same tags as `udev_device_get_tags_list_entry` if udev device is created with `udev_monitor_receive_device`. Works correctly if device is created with `udev_device_new_from_syspath`.

Problem seems to be that `udev_device` created from monitor has `sd_device` with `database_version == 0`.

Pull request https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/17622 added `device_database_supports_current_tags` that checks if `database_version` is `>=1`. If check fails, current_tags just returns regular tags.

Same problem if device is created with `udev_device_new_from_environment`.

review_comments: Hmm, this change is not described in the commit message. If it's done, I'd prefer it to be split out to a separate commit. But I don't think it makes much sense: if `ret==NULL`, `device_get_properties_strv` doesn't make much sense.
